timestamp.Description: Device timestamp of the sample (Tobii Glasses 2 API clock).

x_coordinate.Description: Horizontal gaze position, normalized 0-1 in the scene-camera video frame (populated only for type=gp).

y_coordinate.Description: Vertical gaze position, normalized 0-1 in the scene-camera video frame (populated only for type=gp).

z.Description: Third coordinate/vector component for 3D streams (gp3, gd, pc); n/a for 2D gaze rows.

status.Description: Tracking/validity status flag for the sample.

gidx.Description: Gaze index: monotonically increasing sample counter grouping messages that belong to the same sample.

type.Description: Signal type carried by this row.

eye.Description: Eye the row refers to; n/a for binocular/scene streams.

value.Description: Scalar payload whose meaning depends on `type` (e.g. pupil diameter in mm for type=pd; TTL level for type=sig).

direction.Description: TTL signal direction for type=sig rows; n/a otherwise.

Levels.in: signal received by the device from external hardware
Levels.out: signal sent by the device to external hardware

et_time_s.Description: Recording time of the sample, in seconds from recording onset.
